ῥήτωρ.definition: one who gives sentence, judge, S.Fr.1090; advocate, POxy.37.4 , etc

ῥίζις.definition: an Ethiopian animal of the elephant kind, Str.17.3.5

ῥίσκος.definition: coffer, chest, esp. for plate or money; sarcophagus, IG14.1934f3

ῥῖψις.definition: throwing, hurling; being thrown or hurled, Pl.R.378d; Plu.Lys.12; throwing oneself, Id.2.166a

ῥοάς.definition: shedding of fruit, a disease of vines, f.l. for Thphr.HP4.14.6

ῥοΐδιον.definition: Dim. of small pomegranate; rind of pomegranate, Gloss

ῥομφαία.definition: large, broad sword, used by the Thracians

ῥόπαλον.definition: club, cudgel, used to beat an ass; membrum virile, APl.4.261

ῥοῦς.definition: Att. contr. for; and uncontr. acc. sg. masc

ῥυάς.definition: fluid, flaccid, flabby; falling off, hair that is shed, Id.Pr.898a32; a vine that sheds its grapes, Thphr.HP4.14.6 , Gp.5.39.1

ῥύμα.definition: = anything that flows, stream, IG9 .692.5 : metaph., Orph.H.10.22; Procl.H.1.4

ῥύτις.definition: = in a play on words, Ps.-Democr. ap. Zos.Alch.p.119 B

ῥύτρος.definition: a plant with prickles at the ends, globe-thistle, Echinops viscosus, Thphr.HP6.4.4

ῥακτήριος.definition: fit for striking with; broken, discordant , Id.Fr.699

ῥάκωσις.definition: a becoming ragged or wrinkled, of the skin, when the flesh under it is shrunk, Sor.2.40, Zen.6.42

ῥάμφος.definition: crooked beak of birds of prey: generally, beak, bill, Ar.Av.99, Pl.Com.138, Plu.2.980e; cf

ῥανίς.definition: semen virile, AP10.45; metaph., drop, spot, Ael.NA17.23, cf. 38; Philostr.VA3.48

ῥαντήρ.definition: one who wets, esp. of the; sprinkler, Mon.Ant.23.150

ῥαχόω.definition: cover with wattle-work, prob. in IG22.463.82

ῥηξίνοος.definition: breaking the wits, of Dionysus, ib.524.18

ῥητινόω.definition: flavour with resin, Dsc.Eup.2.65: pf. part. Pass. mixed with resin, Hp.Art.62

ῥητότης.definition: rationality, of numbers, Iamb.in Nic.p.91 P

ῥήτρα.definition: Ion. Elean v. infr; in the Doric and Elean dialects, compact, treaty, SIG9

ῥιγέω.definition: cool or slacken in zeal, Pi.N.5.50; bristle with arms, . . Theoc.l.c

ῥιζοφυής.definition: putting out roots, ib.1.8.1; growing from a root, Id.HP7.10.1

ῥίζωμα.definition: the mass of roots of a tree; element, Emp.6.1; Pythag.15

ῥιναυλέω.definition: blow through the nose, snort, from anger, cj. for in Luc.Lex.19

ῥινάω.definition: lead by the nose, Pherecr.23, Men.895:—Pass., we were chaffed, Alciphr.Fr.6.2

ῥίνημα.definition: that which is filed; an eyesalve, Gal.12.778

ῥινολαβίς.definition: instrument for taking hold of the nose, Id

ῥινοτόμος.definition: piercing shields or hides, dub.l. for in Nonn.D.21.87

ῥιπή.definition: poet. Noun, swing or force with; flapping of wings, A.Pr.126 , cf. E.Fr.594.4; buzz of a gnat's wing, A.Ag.893; of the lyre's quivering notes, Pi.P.1.10

ῥιπτάζω.definition: Frequentat. of throw to and fro, toss; Pass. also, = AP5.164

ῥίψοπλος.definition: throwing away one's arms, of a panic flight, A.Th.315

ῥοδόμηλον.definition: Dor. rose-apple: metaph; a confection of roses and quinces, Alex.Trall.1.10

ῥοῖζος.definition: Ion. whistling or whizzing of an arrow; rushing motion, rush, swing, Plu.Marc.15, Demetr.21, Epic. in Arch.Pap. 7 p.4

ῥύγχαινα.definition: with a large nose or snout, Lat. nasuta, Gloss

ῥύπασμα.definition: dirt, filth, pollution, Apollon.Lex. s.v. but is f.l. in Eust.1849.12

ῥυπάω.definition: Ep. to be filthy, slovenly; Pass., to be filled with wax, of the ear, prob. in S.Fr.858
